summary: BLUT and Katana process adapters are merged into OpenWarrant; Katana native receipt interfaces merged upstream at 5a735133 with all hosted checks passing. A candidate core collector enrollment codec checks exact current authority, human-admin signature policy, executable/provider identity and explicit Warrant scope. Eight synthetic-adapter controls and 705 core regressions pass. Protected cryptographic enrollment workflow, operator custody, activation, native collector wiring and independent/participant qualification remain open. A candidate reference OpenSSH transport verifies exact enrollment bytes; four crypto/SDK controls, 17 process regressions and all-target/all-feature CLI Clippy pass, with two native-provider cases explicitly not run in this observation. Protected activation and collector wiring remain open. The candidate execution loader checks actual UID and protected paths, authenticates enrollment, and rechecks authority per use. Three loading controls, four crypto controls, an authority CLI regression, an explicitly run two-UID namespace roundtrip and strict CLI Clippy pass. Core enrollment is merged at d05cf826 after the full CI gate. Activation, native collector wiring, launch fencing and operator/independent qualification remain open.
next_steps: Implement reference signature verification and protected collector enrollment/activation; pure SDK checks do not authenticate or isolate the host.
Wire trusted collector policy and native verifier into the actual workflow request/response path; preserve UNKNOWN for absent custody, spend or confinement observations.
Complete actual provider integrations, independent verification and participant qualification without inventing acceptance.
